fix: The ADR-0048 Slice B verdict-cache probe fires PRE-BUILD on the fresh worktree, so every lane launched from the same main tip carries the identical base tree_sha and 'matches' every earlier cycle whose probe also ran pre-build on that tip. Before any enforce flip: the cache key must distinguish a POST-BUILD tree (real re-land candidate) from an untouched base tree — e.g. only record/match when the worktree tree differs from the cycle's base HEAD tree, or key on (base_sha, post_build_tree_sha). Add a regression test: two fresh cycles on the same tip must NOT match each other. The shadow dataset collected so far (2026-08-14 batch: 4 matches, all tree b1ae51b3, spanning PASS/WARN sources and including a just-queued item nothing had worked on) is contaminated by this class and cannot justify promotion.
notes: Live evidence 2026-08-14 batch (cycles 1457-1460+): shadow lines matched cycle=1457 PASS then cycle=1459 WARN for FOUR different lanes including one whose inbox item was created minutes earlier — impossible as genuine re-land. Would-skip under enforce = skipping tdd/build/audit on fresh unbuilt cycles with a stale verdict. | LIVE DOUBLE EVIDENCE batch-20260815c wave-1: BOTH sibling fresh worktrees (worktree-retry-diagnostic-integrity + context-fill-telemetry-and-cap) logged [verdict-cache SHADOW] tree_sha=6c73f03e6500... matched cycle=1477 verdict=PASS "would skip tdd/build/audit" — two unbuilt fresh bases matching a prior PASS in one wave. Confirms enforce (ADR-0048 Slice B) MUST NOT flip until the probe excludes pre-build base trees (e.g. only match post-build tree_sha, or key on base_sha+diff_sha). | 2026-08-16 cycle-1492 retry: product predicates C1492_* ALL GREEN — sole red is the INHERITED C1488_003 (inverted oracle, unsatisfiable on any tree). NEXT ADOPTION: fix that one predicate FIRST (plain Go negation: read file, assert !strings.Contains — no new primitive needed), then the cycle ships on existing work.
summary: verdict-cache shadow matches are fresh-base collisions: pre-build probe on an untouched worktree matches every sibling cycle from the same main tip. The shadow soak's would-reuse data is contaminated; enforce would skip the pipeline spine on fresh cycles.
title: ADR-0048 verdict-cache: pre-build probe collides on the unchanged base tree — enforce would reuse stale verdicts for unbuilt cycles
